vetSays.line: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "Nothing grows here but dirt and tents. Past the treeline — that's where the green is. That's where the food is."
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Company makes the road shorter.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +3 clean.

🛟 the person in their 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm stands up by the fire. "We can't just watch the fever in the tents happen. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Or we rally," the person in their 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
📓 Journal: the person in their 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm proposed relief (sickness), day 1.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
"Can we talk?" A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)

You catch fragments by the fire — Stanisław telling A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.

A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
🛡️ Logan, Colleen, Heinrich, Renata and Emma met them at the door — 5 put down. Logan, Colleen, Heinrich, Renata, Emma are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The Scarred Sweeps Week is on you — no warning, just teeth.
Scarred Sweeps Week hits you for 7.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Stanisław strikes the Scarred Sweeps Week.
The Scarred Sweeps Week falls.
📺 Stanisław brought down Scarred Sweeps Week. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Stanisław brought down Scarred Sweeps Week. Together.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Logan, Colleen, Heinrich, Stanisław and Emma met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Logan, Colleen, Heinrich, Stanisław, Emma are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stanisław just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Colleen just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Logan, Colleen, Heinrich, Renata and Stanisław met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Colleen, Heinrich, Renata, Stanisław are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stanisław just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

Stanisław strikes the Scarred Cliffhanger.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Cliffhanger falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Cliffhanger!
📺 You brought down Scarred Cliffhanger. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Scarred Cliffhanger.
You catch Renata telling the fire about Stanisław. "You brought down Scarred Cliffhanger." The story's already growing.
You catch Colleen telling the fire about Stanisław. "You brought down Scarred Cliffhanger." The story's already growing.
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Extended Warranty falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Extended Warranty!
🛡️ Jayden, Dina and Fiston met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Jayden, Dina, Fiston are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
🛡️ Fiston and Boris met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Fiston, Boris are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chantal just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ THE WAR PATH — A moment of respect, from something that rarely respects. THE HERALD came. Named and located — the war council knew its face. They faced The Big Beast and lived to sit here. They faced Loud-Eyes and lived to sit here. 2 more of the later drafts faced besides. Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
